patterns.note: Full-bleed dark background sections with centered, often horizontally constrained content blocks, creating a sense of spaciousness and focus.
Dramatic contrast between oversized, bold serif display headings and smaller, clean sans-serif body text and uppercase labels, establishing a strong visual hierarchy.
A sophisticated palette dominated by deep black, accented with rich gold, and complemented by crisp white or light grey text for a luxurious feel.

The hero section features a multi-layered parallax effect where a central image, large statement text, and subtle background graphics (concentric circles) move at different speeds during scroll, creating depth and engagement.
Talent profiles are presented in a dynamic, asymmetrical grid layout with individual images and names, breaking from typical uniform card displays.

technique_notes: The site employs a smooth scrolling experience, likely powered by locomotive-scroll, which enables advanced scroll-triggered animations and a custom scroll behavior.

Hero elements, including the central image, large display text, and abstract background graphics, are animated with a parallax effect, moving at varying speeds relative to the scroll position to create a sense of depth and dynamism.
Sections below the hero reveal themselves with subtle fade-in and slight upward slide animations as they enter the viewport, enhancing content discovery and guiding the user's eye.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold serif headings (~4-5x body text) create a strong visual hierarchy, complemented by smaller, clean sans-serif body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are prevalent across most elements, with subtle rounding applied only to interactive elements like buttons and input fields.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and generous vertical spacing between major content sections, creating a sense of luxury and allowing elements to breathe, while internal grids maintain a balanced density.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a deep black background paired with striking gold accents and monumental serif typography creates an immediate impression of luxury and authority. The sophisticated, multi-layered parallax scrolling in the hero, combined with the abstract gold concentric circles as a recurring motif, elevates it beyond a standard marketing site, making the scroll experience itself a key part of the brand expression.
